annotations.title: Romania industry benchmark: top companies by CAEN code

description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base, no account). Use when you need market leaders or competitors in a Romanian industry, or to place a company against its peers. Romania industry benchmark: ranks active Romanian companies with a given main CAEN code (NACE-based activity code) by turnover (cifra de afaceri) from their latest balance sheet, with employees, net profit and year. Returns top N (5-20, default 15), total with data and, if cui is given and in the top N, its rank (rang_ref).

code.description: CAEN activity code (cod CAEN, 4 digits), e.g. 4752. A company's main CAEN is in romania_company_profile.cod_caen.

cui.description: Optional CUI to highlight (is_ref) and rank within the list.
